<thought>Using the most intense ESI peak (m/z 183.0451) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈182.0378 Da. Matching this mass to plausible formulas containing C, H, O, and possibly N, the best fit is C₈H₈NO₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 182.0453 Da, within a few ppm). The observed M+1 peak intensity (~10 %) also matches the expected ¹³C contribution for 8 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H8NO4.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8NO4</final_answer>
